note: Brent (January contract) settled little changed at $91.98/bbl on 19 Nov, down from $95.82 a week earlier, while WTI (December) settled at $83.21, both pressured by an EIA report showing larger-than-expected builds in US crude and gasoline stockpiles for the week to 13 Nov. Gains were capped by renewed Gulf tensions — a Houthi missile hit the PIF tower in Riyadh's financial district on 19 Nov, and the Houthis separately claimed unverified strikes on a Jubail petrochemical complex and Jizan — plus Reuters reporting that Ukrainian drone strikes have cut Russian oil refining by about 45% since late October. TTF rose to about €85.69/MWh on 20 Nov and JKM to $27.52; Henry Hub held near $3.17, still largely insulated from the Gulf and Red Sea turmoil.
